test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 27 Sept 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Integrated approach in S&T for Sustainable Future' is the theme for which one of the following?
solution:
The correct answer is **"__National Science Day 2022__".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Integrated Approach in Science and Technology for Sustainable Future" is the focus of National Science Day.**
 
• The theme for National Science Day was **introduced in January by Dr. Jitendra Singh, the Union Minister of Science and Technology.**
 
• According to a statement released by the Department of Science and Technology, Singh emphasised that a **four-fold integrated strategy in Science and Technology for a sustainable future** will help us **break our culture of working in silos** (DST).
 
• According to the statement, **Prime Minister Narendra Modi proposed this four-fold integrated approach** to play a leading role in the international arena.
 
• According to Singh, the four-fold method would integrate all scientific divisions that might operate using a theme-based approach. **Which are:**
 
 
• Extended scientific action that also includes engineering
 
• Institutions, both medical and otherwise
 
• Additional scientific integration entails determining the requirements of other ministries, including Jal Shakti and the Railways, among others.
 
• A comprehensive, science-driven approach incorporating startups and industry.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• India celebrates the day on July 1 as ‘National Doctor’s Day’ and it’s organized by the Indian Medical Association (IMA) annually.
 
 
• The theme of **National Doctors Day **2022 is ‘Family Doctors on the Front Line’.
 
 
 
• In India, where '**Teacher's Day** is celebrated on 5 September, 'International Teacher's Day is celebrated on 5 October.
 
• National Engineers Day is celebrated on 15 September.
 
 
• It is celebrated to pay tribute to Sir M. Visvesvaraya, one of the most visionary and eminent civil engineers the country has had.
 
• It was first celebrated in 1968.
